subject: Environmental Science & Ecology
question: Which of the following are some important pollutants released by steel industry in India? 1. Oxides of sulphur 2. Oxides of nitrogen 3. Carbon monoxide 4. Carbon dioxide Select the correct answer using the code given below.
explanation: Air pollution from the steel industry is the result of emission of particulate matter containing minerals (iron, iron oxide), metals (cadmium, lead, chromium, nickel, zinc, copper and arsenic) and other pollutants (polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons, nitrogen oxides and sulphur dioxide). Steel industry is also a source of carbon dioxide, carbon monoxide emissions which is generated during iron and steel making operations, either as a result of the reaction of coke with iron oxide in the blast furnace or from a power plant producing electricity used in the production of steel. Hence (d) is the correct answer.
source: Environment & Ecology GS · Environment & Ecology GS p.54
